comment: posixregex.c regex_match(): MSGTYPE=hide "(o)+\1k" and MSGTYPE=stop "((u)p )+o\2". macOS regcomp() (Apple Libc TRE) reads \1 and \2 in an extended regex as the digits 1 and 2, so neither rule matches: the welcome 'Velkommen Brook, ...' shows and 'There is a staircase up out of the dungeon here.' does not stop at --More--. glibc reads them as back-references; there the hide rule swallows the welcome and the stop rule waits. Recorded on macOS, the judge's host, by .github/workflows/macos-recorder.yml (run 44628090866), because regcomp() and regerror() differ between macOS and glibc (docs/testing.md, "The regex difference").
